      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Validating outbound message headers prevents potential buffer overruns and crashes in transport encoding. As noted in the description, an oversized message type causes V1 transport encoding to abort and V2 transport to truncate or write past its encoding buffer."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies sendmsgtopeer in src/rpc/net.cpp to validate outbound payload size.",
      "band": "P4",
      "score": 0.2,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Improves parameter validation in the sendmsgtopeer debugging RPC. Payloads exceeding 4 MB now fail immediately with an RPC error rather than silently triggering peer disconnection downstream."
    },
